title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Law concerning the Conditions for Applying for Advance Payment by the Basic Medical Insurance Fund

articles.content_en:
Higher People's Court of Anhui Province:
We have received your Request for Instructions on the Legal Application Issues of the Conditions for Advance Payment by Basic Medical Insurance Funds. Upon deliberation, the reply is as follows:
According to Article 30 of the Social Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China and Articles 2 and 3 of the Interim Measures for Advance Payment from Social Insurance Funds, where an individual participating in basic medical insurance (hereinafter referred to as the insured person) is injured or ill due to a tortious act of a third party, and the part of the medical expenses that shall be borne by the third party according to law is not paid by the third party, or the third party cannot be ascertained, the basic medical insurance fund shall make advance payment. When the insured person submits a written application for advance payment to the social insurance agency at the place of insurance, he/she shall inform the agency of the cause of the injury or illness and the circumstances that the third party fails to pay the medical expenses or cannot be ascertained. After review according to law, the social insurance agency shall make advance payment of the corresponding part of the medical expenses in accordance with the provisions on basic medical insurance fund payment in the coordinated region.
The right of the insured person to apply for advance payment from the basic medical insurance fund according to law shall not be affected by whether he/she has paid the medical expenses at the time of settlement; where the social insurance agency refuses to make advance payment solely on the ground that the insured person has paid the medical expenses at the time of settlement, and the insured person files a prosecution requesting an order to compel the social insurance agency to make advance payment, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law. The social insurance agency may recover the medical expenses advanced according to law in accordance with Articles 11 and 12 of the Interim Measures for Advance Payment from Social Insurance Funds.
